LanguageData.LP_Class_Bard.label: bard
LanguageData.LP_Class_Bard.description: The DND bard casts with song and word: Vicious Mockery (cantrip), Bardic Inspiration, Healing Word, Hideous Laughter, Song of Rest, Jack of All Trades (passive), Countercharm, Confusion, Song of Renown, Magical Secrets (learn one spell from another casting class at levels 10 / 13 each), Mislead, and ultimately Words of Creation. Choose a college at level 3: Lore, Valor, Swords or Eloquence. Power uses "inspiration power" (Social or Artistic, Charisma); damage and healing are multiplied by psychic sensitivity (when the setting is on). Resource: cadence (max 2 + bard level + Charisma modifier; slowly regained while awake, faster while sleeping, faster still when playing instruments, listening to music or making art, +0.2 for each chat).
